Name: Abrah's pink snow bunny
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[list]
Pink Snow Bunny 1.0.1 (CP)This mod replaces the Rabbits in Stardew Valley with a pink coquette retexture called Pink Snow Bunny. It brings a cuter, custom style to your farm without editing the original game files.[line]Requirements[list]
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/utility/smapi]SMAPI by Pathoschild[/url]: the community mod loader that allows Stardew Valley to run mods.
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/content-patcher]Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/url]: the framework that replaces images safely without overwriting the base files.
[/list][line]Installation[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI by Pathoschild.

[*]Install Content Patcher by Pathoschild.

[*]Download this mod.

[*]Unzip the download. Inside you will see a folder named Pink Snow Bunny (CP).

[*]Place that folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[*]Do not place the entire zip file in Mods — only the folder inside it.

[/list][/list][line]Finding the Mods folder[list]
[*]On Steam (Windows): [code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]
[*]On Mac or Linux: check the Stardew Valley installation path and look for a folder named [code]Mods[/code].
[*]If it does not exist, create one manually.
[/list][line]Features[list]
[*]Replaces all Rabbits with Pink Snow Bunny.
[*]Works with new or existing saves.
[*]Easy to install and remove.
[*][i]Art and design by Abrah.[/i]
[*][i][/i]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Pink Snow Bunny
Manifest.Description: Replaces the vanilla rabbit with a pink snow bunny.
